features: Inline @ picker for active people, issues, projects and documents using native resource records.
Enter/Tab selection, arrow navigation, Escape dismissal and no-results state.
Mentions serialize to provider URL Markdown; API-created URL mentions render as linked chips in comments and editors.
Profile and document links open twin pages; document edits write native GraphQL content with a stale-revision guard.
Insertion retains the existing paragraph and subsequent typing; wrapped chips keep a clickable rectangular area.

desktop_flows: Person, document, issue-ID and project search/selection
Comment submit via keyboard with all four canonical URLs
Readback as native Markdown and rendered chips
mobile_flows: Enter selection, immediate native undo/redo and comment submission
Wrapped document mention follows semantic link without coordinate fallback after chip layout fix
Document native save/reload with mention preserved in a single paragraph
validation.final_document_markdown: Ship the Linear twin with https://linear.app/linear-twin/profiles/ada review

limitations: Provider documentation comparison; no authenticated live Linear UI or pixel-level comparison in this change.
Mention notifications, automatic relations, date/PR mentions, AI agents, cross-user realtime collaboration and complete profile/document feature sets remain open.
Resource rename/URL alias behavior requires separate provider conformance.
CI, production deployment and hosted checks pending.
review_fixes: Person mention catalog uses the same stable URL as GraphQL User.url and also recognizes documented workspace profile URLs.
Native document slug identities are unique and deterministic from resource IDs, remain stable after rename, and preserve old-title mention URLs. Duplicate-title documents keep distinct links.
